title: Income and expenses
description: Income and expenses outside sales, their categories, documents and the period summary. Service and product sales are listed as income automatically.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view income and expenses.
empty_filtered_description: Change the filters and try again.
detail_description: The record, its cash movement and history. Records are never deleted; a wrong one is reversed or corrected.
detail_not_found: The record was not found or you are not allowed to view it.
fields.account_placeholder: Pick a cash or bank account
fields.account_hint: The amount is posted to this account at the same time.
fields.account_none: You have no active cash or bank account you can use.
fields.name: Name
entries.empty_description: Add income or an expense; sales show up here on their own.
summary.net_hint: Sales + other income − expenses (staff payouts, transfers and product cost excluded)
summary.empty: No sales, income or expenses in this period.
summary.load_failed: The summary could not be loaded.
summary.categories_empty_description: This stays empty while the period has no income or expense records.
categories.title: Income and expense categories
categories.description: Default categories come with every business; you can add your own. A used or default category is archived instead of deleted. Changes need access to every branch.
categories.empty_description: Add an income or expense category.
categories.columns.name: Name
category_dialog.description: The name must be unique within the type; the type cannot change later.
entry_dialog.description: Money in or out outside sales. The amount is posted to the picked account at the same time; staff payouts are not entered here.
classify_dialog.title: Reclassify the record
classify_dialog.description: Changes category, description and staff member; use a correction for amount, date or account.
correct_dialog.title: Correct the record
correct_dialog.description: The old record is reversed with today's date and a new one is written in its place. Both stay in the history.
reverse_dialog.title: Reverse the record?
reverse_dialog.description: The exact opposite is written with today's date and the cash movement is reversed. The record is not deleted.
document.title: Document
document.download_failed: The document could not be downloaded.
document.hint: Receipt, invoice or bank slip: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 10 MB.
document.too_large: The file can be at most 10 MB.
document.upload_failed_after_create: The record was saved but the document could not be uploaded; try again from the record's page.
document.remove_description: The record no longer shows the document; the file is kept for the audit trail.
validation.amount_positive: The amount must be greater than zero.
validation.description_max: The description can be at most 500 characters.
validation.reason_min: The reason must be at least 3 characters.
validation.reason_max: The reason can be at most 500 characters.
validation.name_max: The name can be at most 120 characters.
validation.sort_order: The order must be 0 or a positive whole number.
